heroHeadline: Ukraine Talks Widen to Europeans as Board of Peace Warns Gaza Ceasefire Could Collapse
heroSubtitle: November 18, 2026 — Ukraine, US envoys and five European states held online talks on Nov 16 and agreed to meet in Berlin, while Russia says no date is set for another round. The Board of Peace told the UN Security Council the Gaza ceasefire may collapse without immediate implementation steps.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, African Union, IGAD, Crisis Group, USIP, PA-X Database, and Tier 1–3 sources across all media poles.
